referents.why: Third masculine singular subject of the wayyiqtol 'and said' after 'he answered Job'. The one answering Job is the LORD (w2); Job is the object.

links.why: Wayyiqtol continues the narrative line within the verse; 'and then' is the form's relation.

cant_tell.what: The speech introduced by 'and said' (cl1) has its content from 38:2 onward. Its content link and turn are recorded at 38:2, where the first said clause is judged.
cant_tell.why: A link from this saying clause cannot be written forward into a later verse from here, so it is recorded once, at the first said clause.
